entries.en: <mothertongue l="mex" m="idiota" b="Maybe that'll teach that " a=" to pay his debts on time. And if it doesn't, then he won't be runnin' away that easy."/>

entries.en: Less panic, more cut. Achilles tendon is the big one, above the heel.
entries.ro: Mai puțină panică, mai mult tăiat. Tendonul lui Ahile e cel mare, deasupra călcâiului.
